verses.text: Family, because God has shown you mercy, offer your whole selves as a living sacrifice—holy and pleasing to God. That’s your real act of worship.
Don’t copy the world’s pattern. Let God transform you by renewing your mind, so you can recognize what he wants—what’s good, pleasing, and complete.
By the grace God gave me, I’m telling everyone among you: don’t think you’re more important than you are. Think clearly and honestly, in line with the faith God has given each of you.
Our bodies have many parts, and each part has its own job.
In the same way, even though we’re many, we’re one body in Christ—and we belong to each other.
We have different gifts because God gave us different grace. If your gift is prophecy, use it in line with your faith.
If it’s serving, serve. If it’s teaching, teach.
If it’s encouraging, encourage. If you give, do it generously. If you lead, stay diligent. If you show mercy, do it gladly.
Love for real—no faking. Hate what’s evil; hold tight to what’s good.
Love each other like family. Take the lead in showing honor to one another.
Don’t slack off. Keep your spirit fired up as you serve the Lord.
Celebrate the hope you have. Stay strong in trouble. Keep showing up in prayer.
Share what God’s people need, and make room for guests. 🏠
Bless the people who persecute you. Bless them; don’t curse them.
Celebrate with people who are celebrating; cry with those who are crying.
Live in harmony with each other. Don’t chase status; hang with humble people. Don’t act like you know everything.
Don’t pay anyone back with evil. Do what everyone can recognize as honorable.
If it’s possible—and as far as it depends on you—live at peace with everybody.
Dear friends, don’t take revenge yourselves. Leave room for God’s anger. Scripture says, “I’m the one who takes revenge; I’ll pay it back, says the Lord.”
Instead, “If your enemy is hungry, feed them. If they’re thirsty, give them a drink. Doing that is like piling burning coals on their head.”
Don’t let evil beat you. Beat evil by doing good.
